summary: Peaceful bot bug fix verified. Engine harness (node scripts/engine_test.js) reports 'RESULT: 77 passed, 0 failed' with the three required PASS lines: 'peaceful bot does NOT strike first', 'attacking a peaceful bot provokes it', 'provoked peaceful bot fights back'. Frontend smoke on mobile viewport (390x844): New Game -> Single Player -> difficulty-peaceful -> start-game -> Skip tutorial worked. game-screen renders correctly; End Turn advanced turn indicator T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> T4 across 3 taps. No red screen / crash / blank state detected. Only benign React Native Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents) observed in console.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and inline pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.

rca_of_issue: Fix (per E1): added Player.provoked flag; engine.attackUnit sets provoked=true on the defender's owner; ai.ts only engages combat when cfg.aggressive || provoked, so peaceful (aggressive=false) bots stay passive until the human attacks them, matching the required rule. Verified deterministically by engine_test.js.
